label: Easy
description: Plain UCB1 with random playouts and MCTS-Solver for tactical sharpness, ~1s per move.

label: Medium
description: UCB1 with MAST-biased playouts and MCTS-Solver for tactical sharpness, ~2s per move.

label: Strong
description: N-gram-guided (NST) decisive-move search with MCTS-Solver for tactical sharpness, ~3s per move, searching one shared tree across all available CPU cores.

label: Master
description: Same search as Strong, parallelized the same way, with a longer ~8s thinking budget.

label: CNN A gen400 (9x9 only)
description: The 64x4 size-agnostic residual CNN trained at 9x9 in run A (200-simulation self-play, value target half game outcome and half search value, games played to the engine's material bound from generation 323), generation 400, with a 100-simulation Gumbel search. The latest Druid net. Only plays 9x9 boards.

label: CNN A gen300 (9x9 only)
description: The 64x4 size-agnostic residual CNN trained at 9x9 in run A (200-simulation self-play, value target half game outcome and half search value), generation 300, with a 100-simulation Gumbel search. It scored 0.60 against generation 240. Only plays 9x9 boards.

label: CNN A gen240 (9x9 only)
description: The 64x4 size-agnostic residual CNN trained at 9x9 in run A (200-simulation self-play, value target half game outcome and half search value, forked from run H generation 200), generation 240, with a 100-simulation Gumbel search. It beat run H's continuation 75-25. Only plays 9x9 boards.

label: CNN H gen200 (9x9 only)
description: The 64x4 size-agnostic residual CNN trained at 9x9 in run H (200-simulation self-play, warm-started from generation 309), generation 200, with a 100-simulation Gumbel search. Only plays 9x9 boards.

label: CNN H gen100 (9x9 only)
description: The 64x4 size-agnostic residual CNN trained at 9x9 in run H (200-simulation self-play, warm-started from generation 309), generation 100, with a 100-simulation Gumbel search. Only plays 9x9 boards.

label: CNN gen309 (9x9 only)
description: The 64x4 size-agnostic residual CNN trained at 9x9 (generation 309) with a 100-simulation Gumbel search, about 0.3 s per move. At 9x9 it scored 0.65 against a 1000-iteration MCTS in a 20-game match. Only plays 9x9 boards.

label: CNN gen60 (7x7 only)
description: The 64x4 size-agnostic residual CNN trained at 7x7 (generation 60) with a 100-simulation Gumbel search, about 0.2 s per move. Only plays 7x7 boards.
